text:
dana_cs: Hi team — SignalTrail onboarding blocked, they hit 403s on /v1/embed during SDK init. Quick log snippet below.

alex_devex: Can you paste the snippet they ran?

dana_cs: They used our node quickstart: ```const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY }); await client.embed.create({ model: 'embed-lite', input: 'test' });```

dana_cs: Log: 403 Forbidden - error=auth.scope_mismatch; note="limiter=client:edge-worker/2.0.0"

taylor_se: Two probable causes: token missing project scope OR their gateway is normalizing x-client header so limiter groups traffic unexpectedly.

signaltrail_rep: We run starter in Cloudflare Workers, fan out requests from worker to our backend then to Redwood. 403s happen mostly during warmup bursts.

alex_devex: CF Workers may strip or rewrite headers and reuse IPs. Our throttler uses token_id + x-client tag. If CF forwards same x-client while tokens vary (or stale), buckets can misclassify -> 403 as scope check fails in some flows.

dana_cs: What's a safe quick fix we can recommend?

alex_devex: Two quick actions: 1) Confirm they use the onboarding project token (not a personal token). Have them decode at jwt.io or hit /token/introspect. 2) I can flip an account flag to ignore client-tagging so limiter uses token_id only while they ramp.

taylor_se: Also tell them to add small jitter to warmup and exponential backoff. Serverless fanouts look like a stampede otherwise. E.g., random delay 50-300ms between requests.

signaltrail_rep: We can rotate token now and pause warmup. Please toggle whatever flag you need.

deploy-bot: queued: account_id=acct_01GZ action=disable_client_tagging requested_by=alex_devex ETA=90s

alex_devex: Flag toggled. Limiter now keyed only to token_id for 10 minutes.

dana_cs: I told them to rotate to onboarding token and resume slowly. Will monitor.

signaltrail_rep: Rotated token. After pausing warmup and retrying: 403s stopped. Saw a few 429s when we resumed full-fan without jitter. Implemented backoff and split into waves, errors cleared.

dana_cs: Great — closing loop. Action items: alex_devex leave flag for 10m then auto-restore; taylor_se add a one-line checklist item about token scope + warmup pacing; I'll follow up with SignalTrail tomorrow for renewal health.

alex_devex: noted.

taylor_se: Will add checklist + short backoff snippet to onboarding playbook.

dana_cs: Thanks all :thumbsup:
